latest.text: 中文语音合成与克隆线，开放权重版本可自托管

strengths: 中文语音自然度高，音色库丰富
零样本克隆只需要几秒参考音频
既有云端 API 也有开源权重
cautions: 多语言表现不均，非中文语言要实测
克隆功能有明确的授权要求，用别人的声音必须获得同意
strengthsEn: High Chinese naturalness with a broad voice library
Zero-shot cloning from a few seconds of reference audio
Both a cloud API and open weights
cautionsEn: Multilingual performance is uneven — test your target languages
Cloning carries explicit consent requirements; using someone's voice needs their permission
items.latestEn: Chinese speech synthesis and cloning, with open weights for self-hosting

items.name: Qwen Embedding 系列

latest.text: Qwen 向量线，含多尺寸与重排序配套

strengths: 中英文检索表现都在第一梯队，多语言覆盖广
尺寸档位多，可按算力挑
许可宽松，配套重排序模型同族
cautions: 指令式检索需要按官方格式写 query，用法不对效果会明显下降
大尺寸档推理开销高
useFor: 需要成套（向量+重排）的场景
strengthsEn: First-tier Chinese and English retrieval with broad multilingual coverage
Many size tiers to match your compute
Permissive licence with a same-family reranker
cautionsEn: Instruction-style retrieval needs the documented query format — getting it wrong visibly degrades results
Large tiers are expensive to run
useForEn: Cases needing vectors and reranking together
items.latestEn: The Qwen embedding line, with multiple sizes and a companion reranker

items.name: Voyage AI 向量线

latest.text: Voyage 检索向量与重排序线，已被 MongoDB 收购

strengths: 检索精度在第三方评测中长期靠前
按领域分了代码、法律、金融等专用模型
重排序模型质量高，常被用来补强其他向量模型
cautions: 闭源只能走 API，数据要出内网
中文表现不如同价位国产方案
被收购后产品线整合方向需留意
useFor: 英文检索精度优先的场景
strengthsEn: Retrieval accuracy has long ranked near the top in third-party evaluation
Domain-specific models for code, law and finance
High-quality rerankers often used to strengthen other embedding models
cautionsEn: Closed, API-only — data leaves your network
Chinese trails same-price domestic options
Watch how the product line consolidates post-acquisition
items.latestEn: The Voyage retrieval and reranking line, now part of MongoDB

items.name: Qwen Coder 系列

latest.text: Qwen 代码专精线，含仓库级与 Agent 档

strengths: 开源代码模型里的第一梯队，仓库级任务表现突出
尺寸档位多，从本地小模型到旗舰都有
中文注释与中文文档理解好
cautions: 通用对话能力弱于同尺寸的通用模型，别拿它当聊天模型
长上下文下的仓库理解仍会丢细节
useFor: 需要私有化的编码场景
strengthsEn: First tier among open code models, strong on repository-level tasks
Many size tiers from small local models to flagships
Good at Chinese comments and documentation
cautionsEn: Weaker at general conversation than a same-size general model — don't use it as a chatbot
Repository understanding still loses detail at long context
items.latestEn: Qwen’s code-specialised line, including repository-level and agent tiers

items.name: Codestral

latest.text: Mistral 代码专精线

strengths: 补全延迟低，适合 IDE 内联场景
支持的语言多，长上下文补全稳定
有开放权重版本
cautions: 仓库级 Agent 任务不如头部代码模型
中文注释与中文语境弱
strengthsEn: Low completion latency, well suited to inline IDE use
Many languages with stable long-context completion
cautionsEn: Repository-level agent work trails the leading code models
Weak on Chinese comments and Chinese context
items.latestEn: Mistral’s code-specialised line
